items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was working down there on Saturday night with Bob Catwell(?) and His Seven Saturday Night Stompers. I was working with him.

ctx.x: Well, she... See, I know the difference. I met her... I got her a job where she is now, at Jimmy Ryan's. She's down at Jimmy Ryan's now. She's got seven pieces down there. I got her that job, and helped her get the men together, you know.

And in fact, she wanted me... I'm the first one she called to go down there and work with her. I was working down there on Saturday night with Bob Catwell(?) and His Seven Saturday Night Stompers. I was working with him. And he told the boss. He said, "Well, I think Freddie's too good. He's taking all the glamour(?) from you, and you won't..." If Freddie gets on it, gets back there with you, they ain't gonna pay you no mind -- they're going to look at him. So he says, "No, it's not a good idea; let Freddie stay…
